div.div: بَاهِرٌ [act. part. n. of 1, Overcoming; &c. And particularly,] (assumed tropical:) Overcoming in light. (JK.) [Hence,] قَمَرٌ بَاهِرٌ (tropical:) A moon that overcomes with its light the light of the stars. (S, A.) And البَاهِرُ (tropical:) The moon; because it outshines the stars: (Msb:) or the full moon. (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
